patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Printful and AliDrop share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Printful and AliDrop share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Printful only if your buying job matches “Print-on-demand fulfillment — Free $0; Growth $24.99/mo (waived after $12k/year sales) wit” rather than AliDrop's shape. Choose AliDrop only if your buying job matches “AliExpress/Temu/Alibaba dropshipping importer — Starter $39/mo, Pro $59/mo, Empire $99/mo,” rather than Printful's shape. Workflow advantage: Printful leans online-storefront; AliDrop leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Printful and AliDrop share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Printful is Print-on-demand fulfillment — Free $0; Growth $24.99/mo (waived after $12k/year sales) with 14-day trial; Enterprise quote. Product print co; AliDrop is AliExpress/Temu/Alibaba dropshipping importer — Starter $39/mo, Pro $59/mo, Empire $99/mo, Unicorn $299/mo; $1 for 7-day trial on paid tiers.
- Workflow coverage skew: Printful-leaning online-storefront vs AliDrop-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Printful — Not a checkout platform — Shopify/Woo/Etsy/etc. (or Printful Stores add-on) required; AliDrop — Not a storefront — Shopify/Woo/etc. required.

Limitations — Printful: Not a checkout platform — Shopify/Woo/Etsy/etc. (or Printful Stores add-on) required; Product print and shipping costs are separate from the $0–$24.99 subscription; AliDrop: Not a storefront — Shopify/Woo/etc. required; Shipping times and quality vary by marketplace supplier.

Poor-fit cases: Printful is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a checkout platform — Shopify/Woo/Etsy/etc. (or Printful Stores add-on) required · AliDrop is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a storefront — Shopify/Woo/etc. required · Avoid Printful if you actually need AliDrop's motion (AliExpress/Temu/Alibaba dropshipping importer — Starter $39/mo, Pro $59/mo, Empi)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
